Xplor Data Migration Tools — User Guide (Web App)

Web version
This guide covers the browser-based version of the tools — no download or install required. Everything runs at a URL your team will share with you (protected by a login or password). This replaces the old desktop XplorValidator.exe app.

Overview

Xplor Data Migration Tools is a suite of browser-based tools for validating, cleaning, and preparing QikKids data for import into Xplor.

Your data never leaves your browser
Every file you upload is parsed, validated, and transformed entirely on your own computer, in the browser tab. Nothing is uploaded to a server, logged, or stored anywhere else — you'll see a "Files never leave your browser" badge in the top-right corner of every page as a reminder. When you're done, you download a single .zip file containing all the outputs.

The app includes 5 tools:

ToolWhat it does
Parent and Child ImportValidates migration files, auto-fixes common issues, and generates audit reports
Bookings ImportProcesses and cleans recurring and casual booking exports, splits by service
Payment Plans ImportValidates payment plan CSVs, fixes date/weekday formats, splits by service
Balance AdjustmentsMaps balance adjustment data to Xplor services and produces per-centre import files
Room & Fee Names checkingChecks QikKids booking fee and room names against Xplor definitions

All tools share a single service ID mapping that you set up once per browser tab — see below.

Getting Started

What you need

  • The app URL — ask your team lead for the link (and password, if one is set)
  • Your service ID mapping — either a handful of services you can type in directly, or a serviceIDs.csv file for larger projects

Step 1 — Open the app

Go to the app URL in any modern browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari). If your team has set up an access gate, you may be asked to log in or enter a shared password first — this is expected and only needs to be done once per browser session.

There's nothing to install and nothing to download to get started. Just open the link.

Step 2 — Pick a tool

From the home page, click any tool card to open it. Every tool page has an ← All tools link at the top-left to bring you back here.

Step 3 — Set up your service ID mapping

Every tool page has a Service ID mapping panel in the left sidebar. This maps QikKids service IDs to Xplor service IDs and names, and it's shared automatically across all 5 tools for the rest of your browser session — you only set it up once.

This is optional, but strongly recommended: without it, service IDs won't be resolved or corrected. You have two ways to set it up:

Option A — Enter manually (up to 5 services)

  1. Make sure the Enter manually tab is selected
  2. Fill in Service Name, QK Service ID, and Xplor Service ID for each service
  3. Click + Add service for each additional service (up to 5)

Option B — Upload a CSV (any number of services)

  1. Click the Upload CSV tab
  2. If you don't already have a file, click Download CSV template to get a starter file with the right column headers
  3. Click Upload serviceIDs.csv and select your file
Required columns
Only 3 columns are needed: Service Name, QKServiceID, Xplor Service ID. (Older serviceIDs.csv files with extra columns like Service Type or QKDBID still work fine — those columns are just ignored.)
Set up once per session
Your service ID mapping is remembered while the browser tab stays open, across all 5 tools. If you close the tab or restart your browser, you'll need to set it up again next time.

Tool 1 — Parent and Child Import

Validates migration export files against Xplor import rules, auto-fixes common issues, and generates audit reports including cross-service duplicate parent detection.

Inputs

InputDescription
Migration fileCSV or XLSX export from QikKids containing parent, child, and emergency contact records
Import scopeActive only — validate active enrolments only; Active + Waitlist — include waitlisted children
Existing service files (optional)Previously validated service files, used for cross-service duplicate parent detection

Steps

  1. Upload your migration file (CSV or XLSX)
  2. Select your import scope (Active only / Active + Waitlist)
  3. (Optional) Upload existing service files for cross-service duplicate detection
  4. Click Run validation
  5. Review the summary metrics, status banner, and the filterable results table
  6. Click Download all outputs (.zip) to get your files

What the validator checks and fixes

Auto-fixed automatically:

  • State abbreviations normalised (e.g. "New South Wales" → "NSW")
  • Dates converted to standard format
  • Blank first name filled from last name
  • Parent 2 email cleared if it duplicates Parent 1 email — Parent 1 takes priority
  • Emergency contact emails deduplicated within the EC block — if a later emergency contact's email matches an earlier one, the later email is cleared (EC1 takes priority over EC2–EC5)
  • Emergency contact email cleared if it matches Parent 1 or Parent 2 email — a parent who is also listed as an emergency contact will have the duplicate EC email removed
  • Child CRN cleared when it is identical to Parent 1 CRN or Parent 2 CRN — a child and parent cannot share the same CRN
  • Emergency contact boolean fields converted — True/False values in Emergency Contact, Medical Nominee, Collection Nominee, and Excursion Nominee (contacts 1–5) are converted to 1/0

Validated and flagged:

  • Mandatory fields: Service ID, Legacy ID, First/Last Name, DOB, Status, CRN, Room, Enrolment Date
  • CRN format (9 digits + 1 letter)
  • Email, phone, postcode, and boolean field formats
  • Within-upload and cross-service duplicate parents (matched by name + DOB / contact / email)

Severity levels

SeverityMeaning
ERRORMust be fixed before importing into Xplor
WARNINGReview recommended — may not block import
FIXEDIssue detected and automatically corrected

Outputs (inside the downloaded .zip)

FileDescription
split_csvs/[Service Name]_families_import.csvOne CSV per service, ready to import into Xplor
validation_audit_report_[timestamp].xlsxFull audit report with all errors, warnings, and fixes
client_audit_report_[timestamp].xlsxShows all cleared duplicate emails — use this for client reference if required
duplicate_parents_report_[timestamp].xlsxWithin-upload and cross-service duplicate flags

Tool 2 — Bookings Import

Processes QikKids booking exports into clean, de-duplicated, service-split CSV files ready for import into Xplor.

Inputs

InputDescription
QikKids booking filesOne or more exports (CSV or XLSX) — recurring and casual files can be uploaded together
Default booking end date (optional)Applied to any booking with a blank End Date. Leave empty to fall back to 31/12 of that booking's own Start Date year

Steps

  1. Upload one or more QikKids booking files
  2. (Optional) Set a default booking end date to apply to bookings with a blank End Date
  3. Click Run bookings import
  4. Review the results summary and any conflict warnings
  5. Click Download outputs (.zip) to get your files

What the tool does

  • Detects and removes exact duplicate booking rows
  • Detects recurring schedule overlaps (same child, overlapping date range, shared booking day) — the row with the furthest End Date is kept
  • Removes casual bookings that fall within existing recurring patterns
  • Maps QikKids service IDs to Xplor service IDs
  • Reformats dates to DD/MM/YYYY
  • Fills blank End Dates — uses the default booking end date you enter, if set; otherwise defaults to 31/12 of each booking's own Start Date year
  • Splits output by service and booking type (recurring vs casual)

Outputs (inside the downloaded .zip)

LocationDescription
Recurring/[Service Name]_bookings_import_[date].csvOne file per service — recurring bookings
Casual/[Service Name]_casualbookings_import_[date].csvOne file per service — casual bookings
duplicate_bookings_report_[date].xlsxExact duplicate rows removed, plus a "Recurring Schedule Overlaps" sheet
removed_overlap_report_[date].xlsxCasual bookings removed due to recurring conflicts (only created if any were removed)
Import order
Always import Recurring files into Xplor first, then Casual files.

Tool 3 — Payment Plans Import

Validates payment plan CSVs against Xplor Onboarding Tool rules, auto-fixes date and weekday formats, and splits the output by service.

Inputs

InputDescription
QikKids Service IDs CSVService ID export from QikKids (columns: Dbid, ServiceId, Name). Used to map service names in the payment plan file to QK Service IDs.
Payment plan CSVExported from QikKids
Column mapping (optional)Expand the "Column mapping" section if your file uses non-standard column names
How service mapping works
The payment plan CSV contains QikKids service names but no service IDs. The tool matches each service name against the QikKids Service IDs CSV to find the QK Service ID, then looks that ID up in your service ID mapping (from the sidebar) to get the Xplor Service ID and the correct Xplor service name used in the output files.

Steps

  1. Upload the QikKids Service IDs CSV
  2. Upload your payment plan CSV
  3. (Optional) Expand Column mapping and adjust if your file uses non-standard column names
  4. Click Run checker
  5. Review the summary metrics and error category table
  6. Click Download outputs (.zip) to get your files

Auto-fixes applied

FixWhat it does
Date formatConverts dates to DD/MM/YYYY
Weekday abbreviationConverts full names to 3-letter codes (e.g. "Monday" → "Mon")
WhitespaceStrips leading/trailing spaces from all fields

Error codes

Error CodeMeaning
ERROR_INVALID_PAYMENT_DAYPayment day is Saturday or Sunday
ERROR_MISSING_BOOKING_START_DATEStart Date is empty
ERROR_MISSING_PAYMENT_DAYWeekday is empty
ERROR_MISSING_GUARDIANParent first or last name is missing
ERROR_MISSING_SERVICE_IDNo matching service could be resolved for this row
ERROR_INVALID_FREQUENCYCycle is not Weekly, Fortnightly, or Monthly
MANUAL_PLAN_NOT_MONDAYA manual (paused) plan does not start on Monday
ERROR_NEGATIVE_DIRECT_DEBIT_LIMITDirect debit limit is a negative number
ERROR_NEGATIVE_FIXED_LIMITFixed amount is a negative number
ERROR_ONLY_ONE_AMOUNT_ALLOWEDBoth direct debit limit and fixed amount are set
UNPARSEABLE_DATEStart Date value could not be parsed as a date
UNKNOWN_WEEKDAYWeekday value is not recognised

Outputs (inside the downloaded .zip)

FileDescription
split_csvs/[Xplor Service Name]_payment_plan_import.csvOne CSV per matched service, ready to import into the Onboarding Tool
[input filename]_error_report.xlsxColour-coded 3-sheet Excel error report: Summary, Error Detail, and a dedicated Weekend Errors sheet
Services not in your mapping are skipped
If a service name in the payment plan CSV cannot be matched to a QK Service ID in the QikKids Service IDs CSV, or if that QK Service ID isn't in your service ID mapping, those rows are skipped and no import file is created for that service. Verify the service name spelling matches exactly.

Tool 4 — Balance Adjustments

Processes balance adjustment exports, maps them to Xplor services by centre name, and produces one per-centre import file using the Xplor Balance Adjustments template.

Inputs

InputDescription
Balance adjustment filesOne or more files in CSV, XLSX, or HTML-exported XLS format
Template override (optional)Expand "Advanced — override upload template" to use a custom template XLSX; otherwise the built-in template is used automatically

Steps

  1. Upload one or more balance adjustment files
  2. (Optional) Expand Advanced and upload a custom template file
  3. Click Run balance adjustments
  4. Review the results — created files and any skipped centres
  5. Click Download outputs (.zip) to get your files

What the tool does

  • Accepts CSV, XLSX, and HTML-disguised XLS files
  • Parses Account Name in "Last Name, First Name" format
  • Handles both Credit/Owing column pairs and single signed Amount Due columns
  • Removes rows where Account Name contains "demo parent"
  • Matches centre names to your service ID mapping's Service Name values (exact match, case-sensitive)
  • Applies the template's styling and layout to each output file
  • Also produces a consolidated all-services file and a duplicate-accounts report (when duplicates are found)

Outputs (inside the downloaded .zip)

FileDescription
per_centre/[Centre Name]_Balance_Import.xlsxOne file per matched centre, formatted using the template
All_Services_Balance_Import.xlsxConsolidated file containing every centre's rows
Duplicate_Accounts_Report.xlsxRows where the same person appears more than once (only created if duplicates are found)
Skipped centres
A skipped centre means the centre name in your input file does not exactly match a Service Name in your service ID mapping. Check spelling and capitalisation if a centre is unexpectedly skipped.

Tool 5 — Room & Fee Names checking

Identifies QikKids booking fee and room names that don't exist in Xplor, and suggests possible matches using word-overlap matching.

Inputs

InputDescription
Xplor Active Fees CSVExport from Xplor with columns: Service ID, Fee Name
Xplor Active Rooms CSVExport from Xplor with columns: Centre_Name, Room_Name
QikKids booking filesOne or more booking exports (CSV or XLSX) — recurring and/or casual

Steps

  1. Upload Xplor Active Fees CSV
  2. Upload Xplor Active Rooms CSV
  3. Upload one or more QikKids booking files
  4. Click Run check
  5. Review the mismatch counts and status banner
  6. Click Download mismatch report (.xlsx)

Outputs

FileDescription
Fee_Room_Name_Mismatch_Report.xlsxTwo-sheet Excel report: Fee Mismatches and Room Mismatches

Each sheet shows: QK Service ID, Xplor Service ID, Service Name, the mismatched name, and suggested possible matches.

A green status banner means no mismatches were found. An amber banner means mismatches were detected and need to be resolved in Xplor before importing bookings.

Tips & Troubleshooting

General

IssueSolution
Page asks for a password or loginExpected — the app is access-gated. Ask your team lead for the credentials
Service ID mapping not recognisedSet it up again in the sidebar — it resets when you close the browser tab
Run button stays disabledCheck that every required file (marked with a red *) has been uploaded
Nothing downloads when I click "Download outputs"Check your browser isn't blocking the download/pop-up — allow downloads from this site
A service is skipped / IDs aren't mappedCheck that service or centre names match your service ID mapping exactly (including spacing and capitalisation)

Service ID mapping

  • Set up once per browser tab — it's shared automatically across all 5 tools for the rest of that session
  • Closing the tab or restarting your browser clears it; you'll need to set it up again
  • Up to 5 services can be typed in manually; for more, use the Upload CSV option (download the template first if you don't have a ready-made file)
  • If a tool reports unmapped or skipped services, check that the centre/service names in your input file match your mapping exactly

Downloads

  • Every tool bundles all its output files into a single .zip — there's no separate "output folder" to manage
  • Your original uploaded files are never modified
  • If you run a tool twice, each download gets its own timestamp in the filename, so nothing gets overwritten
  • Check the on-screen summary before downloading — it shows exactly what was produced and how many rows are in each file

Privacy & data handling

This app is designed so that uploaded files never leave your browser:

  • No file is ever sent to a server — all parsing, validation, and report generation happens locally on your computer
  • Nothing is logged or stored beyond your current browser tab
  • The only thing remembered between tools is your service ID mapping (service names and IDs, not any client/child data), and only for as long as the tab stays open

If you're ever unsure, open your browser's Developer Tools → Network tab while using the app — you'll see no requests carrying your file data.
